opening.argument: The video directs viewers to register for and fund a Mirror Trading International account, then send Bitcoin through a QR code or wallet address. It presents the program as a “MOST Exciting Passive Income Opportunity” and ties funded participation to daily statements reporting trading results. Registration also requires confirmation with a sponsor, while viewers are told they may refer friends through their registration link. These instructions show that participation depends not only on funding a purported trading program, but also on sponsor-linked placement and recruitment, supporting the conclusion that the offering is structured around investment returns and referral participation rather than merely explaining financial concepts.

citations.quote: How to register and fund your Mirror Trading International account.
scan the QR code or carefully copy the bitcoin address to your wallet Make the payment by sending the bitcoin
Each day you will receive a statement via email telling you the results of the trades.
You will need to confirm this with your sponsor.
Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link
